= Authentication

Libraries and frameworks for authenticating users in JavaScript and Node.js
applications, including session management and OAuth strategies.

* https://next-auth.js.org/[NextAuth.js]
* https://www.passportjs.org/[Passport.js]
* https://github.com/expressjs/session[expressjs/session]
* https://lucia-auth.com/[Lucia]
* https://github.com/simov/grant[simov/grant - OAuth proxy]
* https://github.com/hapijs/bell[@hapi/bell]
